DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_report_id as "incidentReportId", incident_task_plan_id as "incidentTaskPlanId", completed_at as "completedAt", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.ims_incident_report_task_plan_states WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_report_task_plan_states (incident_report_id, incident_task_plan_id, completed_at, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentReportId, :incidentTaskPlanId, :completedAt, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ims_incident_report_task_plan_states SET completed_at = :completedAt, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_report_id = :incidentReportId AND incident_task_plan_id = :incidentTaskPlanId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ims_incident_report_task_plan_states WHERE incident_report_id = :incidentReportId AND incident_task_plan_id = :incidentTaskPlanId
